feeds.title: Jake Wildwood
feeds.description: I'm Jake Wildwood and my business is located in our family store ('The Wildwood Flower') in Rochester, Vermont. This blog is where I post up glamor shots, history, and information about the instruments that I repair, restore, and sell.

feeds.title: Haze Guitars » Guitar Repair
feeds.description: I'm Gerry Hayes. I repair guitars. I build guitars. I write about guitars. Oh, and I drink tea. A lot of tea. Author of Complete Guitar Wiring and more. Follow Haze Guitars Blog for extra tips and news about guitars

feeds.title: Strange Guitarworks Blog
feeds.description: Strange Guitarworks is New Orleans' premier full-service guitar repair shop, owned and operated by Benjamin Strange and Aaron Younce. Strange Guitarworks is driven by the pursuit of a flawless instrument - a guitar with an amazing feel, perfect intonation, and great tone. We offer a wide range of services: from simple restringing, setups, modifications, and electronics work, all the way up to full restorations.

feeds.title: Wilson Burnham Guitars
feeds.description: Hello! I am Wilson Burnham and welcome to my blog! I handcraft classical guitars in a small studio in Denver, Colorado. I use only hand tools and high-quality wood to make my guitars. As a classical guitar player myself, I know the joy of playing a truly wonderful guitar - one that sings, is responsive to your playing style, with a voice that reaches the last row of seats in a recital or concert hall, and most of all, a guitar that you fall in love with so much you never want to stop playing it.

feeds.title: Mr Glyn's guitar repair
feeds.description: A guitar repair blog by Glyn Evans. Mr. Glyn has been a full-time luthier for 20 years. An ex-lecturer in Guitar making and Repair at The City of Leeds College of Music in the North of England.

feeds.title: Guitar Assembly
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Martin Harmer. The guitars I build are made with a mixture of both traditional and modern techniques and equipment. While I still have much to learn myself, I hope that I can use GuitarAssembly.com to share the knowledge I have acquired so far. Expect to see videos, articles, courses, and full-build walkthroughs on all aspects of guitar making.

feeds.title: Guitar Repair Long Island Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to use this space to answer common questions about guitar maintenance, modifications, and repairs in a clear and detailed manner. These articles are not intended as a step-by-step guide to servicing your own instrument. However, it is our sincere hope that you will find value in the information provided.
